dedupe_keys.name: horizontal to vertical spectral ratios hvsr on earthquake recordings of stations of the 6n network during the activities of the emersito ingv emergency group in ancona italy following the 2022 mw 5 5 costa marchigiana pesarese earthquake

description: Italy’s Istituto Nazionale di Geofisica e Vulcanologia publishes horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratios calculated from earthquakes recorded at eleven temporary 6N stations in Ancona. The network operated after the November 2022 magnitude-5.5 Adriatic earthquake, collecting aftershocks through February 2023. Each comma-separated text file contains frequency in hertz, the mean spectral ratio and bounds one standard deviation below and above it. Zenodo provides the station files publicly and free under CC-BY-4.0. These are derived frequency-domain summaries, not the raw waveforms or a continuous record of ground acceleration. Limited event sampling and site conditions create uncertainty when using ratios as amplification functions. The observations can help constrain local ground-response assumptions for building earthquake simulations. They complement the separately deposited standard spectral ratios and the raw 6N archive, which the provider identifies through DOI 10.13127/sd/qctgd6c-3a. No signal processing was reproduced. Coverage is limited to Ancona.
